action.objective: Play Nxd5, winning a central pawn; Black's recapture cxd5 is available but the d7 knight is Black's and captures by other pieces are illegal.
action.rationale: Nxd5 is the only commit_ready move: verification at effective depth 4 gave exact 353, PV [Nxd5, Qxd7, Ba4], no forced mate, tactical refutation not_found. It wins the d5 pawn; Black's Kxd7/Bxd7/Qxd7 are all illegal (d7 is Black's knight), so the real responses are cxd5 or Qxe3+.
